Container.Name: channels-dvr
Container.Overview:
Channels DVR Server for Unraid.
Based on Debian Bookworm with minimal tini init system.
Key Features: - Proper PUID/PGID mapping (no root-owned files) - TV Everywhere (TVE) support with Google Chrome - Intel QuickSync hardware transcoding (pass /dev/dri) - NVIDIA GPU support (set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all in Advanced settings) - App handles its own updates (including pre-releases)

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Container Path: /channels-dvr - Stores Channels DVR configuration and binary

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Container Path: /shares/DVR - Where recordings are stored

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID - Use 99 for nobody on Unraid

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID - Use 100 for users on Unraid

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPUs to use. Set to 'all' for all GPUs, or specific GPU ID like '0'. Leave empty to disable NVIDIA. Requires Unraid NVIDIA plugin.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA capabilities: compute, video, utility, graphics. Default handles transcoding.
